title: Ok wait, the  NES Tetris world record is now  40.26...
content: Ok wait, the NES Tetris world record is now 40.26 million??! It took 2 hours and 20 minutes and the previous record was 29 million. At level 255, you hit “rebirth” and the pieces slow down to level 0 speeds again. Totally bonkers.
author: Jason Kottke
